name: VirTechnology Contract Manufacturing
old_description: Send us Gerber files, a sourced bill of materials, and any production requirements. Then we use our simple quoting system to provide a fast and accurate quote, and if approved, we continue to production.
about:
VirTechnology Contract Manufacturing operates from Windsor, Vermont, as a start-up contract manufacturer focused on printed circuit board assembly and box-build services. The company was founded to provide turnkey manufacturing solutions for clients across medical, military, aerospace, and weapons sectors, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop delivers turnkey PCB assembly encompassing surface-mount placement, multi-zone solder reflow, through-hole soldering, component procurement, fixture creation, kitting, functional testing, visual inspection, and depanelization via mouse-bite tabs, v-score, or CNC routing. It handles part sizes from 0402 up to 40 mm × 40 mm and targets low-to-medium volume runs, with conformal coating, injection molding, and CNC machining listed as upcoming capabilities.

Customers include original equipment manufacturers and design firms in the medical device, defense, aerospace, and weapons industries that require domestic production to protect intellectual property and supply chains. The company emphasizes its ability to integrate customer-supplied test equipment and procedures into the validation process.

VirTechnology cites its onsite IPC-A-610 certified trainer, a commitment to keeping IP and supply chains within the United States, and a streamlined quoting-to-production workflow as key differentiators. Its stated mission is to “build the best mousetrap, and revitalize American manufacturing.”
